long: Beyond All Reason is a free, open-source real-time strategy game built on the Recoil/Spring engine, inspired by Total Annihilation and Supreme Commander. Players command armies of robotic units, harvest metal and energy, and fight massive battles featuring large unit counts and an economy-driven tech tree. It supports skirmishes against AI as well as large multiplayer and cooperative matches.
name: Beyond All Reason
short: Beyond All Reason (free RTS on the Recoil/Spring engine; engine+assets pre-fetched at build time)
